name: Sound Lance
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature or object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You project a concentrated beam of sonic energy.

The sound deals 1d8 points of sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d8). A sound lance is ineffective in and cannot cross through an area of silence or a similar effect.
